description: This file defines the MerchantStoreService interface which provides methods for managing MerchantStore entities including retrieval by code and saving/updating stores.

classes.name: MerchantStoreService
classes.description: An interface extending generic service to manage MerchantStore entities with methods for retrieval by code and save/update operations.

methods.name: getMerchantStore
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore by its string code.

methods.name: getByCode
methods.description: Retrieves a MerchantStore using an alias for getMerchantStore.

methods.name: saveOrUpdate
methods.description: Saves a new MerchantStore or updates an existing one.
